enrichment.summary: The Board is changing ARISE High School's 2025-2026 Measures N and H plan. It zeroes out a $2,362.50 conference and site visit travel line and uses the same amount to hire an academic mentor for the Public Health Pathway. The money moves within the plan.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Moves $30,000 in Skyline High's Measure N and H plan from teacher pay to two 3D printers
enrichment.summary: The Board is changing Skyline High School's 2025-2026 Measures N and H plan. It lowers a career technical education teacher salary line from $94,919.00 to $64,919.00 and creates a new $30,000.00 line to buy two 3D printers for the Green Pathway. The money moves within the plan.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Accepts an independent auditor's report on Measures N and H compliance for 2024-25
enrichment.summary: EideBailly, an independent auditor, has reported on compliance for Measures N and H for the year ending June 30, 2025. The Board is accepting the report on the recommendation of the Measures N and H Commission. The text states no payment.

items.group: Measures N and H Commission - December 16, 2025 - David Kakishiba, Chairperson

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Cuts $320,635.50 from Syserco's CAL Shape ventilation and plumbing contract after deleting ventilation work
enrichment.summary: The Board is approving a change order that gives the district a $320,635.50 credit because ventilation work is removed at McClymonds High, Roosevelt Middle, Ralph Bunche High and the Gateway to Laney College campus. The contract price drops from $12,040,995.00 to $11,720,359.50. The change comes from preliminary change orders (PCOs) 1 through 4.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds lead-in-water strategy work to Perkins Eastman's master planning contract and extends it to May 2026
enrichment.summary: The Board is amending the Perkins Eastman Architects contract to add work on a districtwide strategy for lead-in-water testing, fixing and long-term management, including three strategy options with school-level cost estimates. The contract end date moves from December 31, 2025 to May 30, 2026 (150 more days), and the cost stays at $1,352,835.00.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No.1, Agreement for General Services – Perkins Eastman Architects DPC – Facilities Master Planning Services Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $34,060 to ACC Environmental's soil testing contract for the Maxwell Park classroom building
enrichment.summary: The Board is adding $34,060.00, which includes a $3,096.00 contingency fee, so ACC Environmental Consultants can take soil samples, test them and write a report on hazardous materials during construction of a new classroom building at the Maxwell Park campus. The contract limit rises from $24,442.50 to $58,502.50.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 2, General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. – MLA at Maxwell Park Campus New Classroom Bldg. Modernization Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $205,307 for Tulum's temporary generator at the Cole data center and extends the term 30 days
enrichment.summary: The Board is adding $205,307.00 so Tulum Innovative Engineering can provide a temporary generator for the Cole data center. The Information Technology Department requires it to keep operating in a power outage, because the server supports about half of the district's network and internet services. The total rises from $43,353.44 to $248,660.44 and the end date moves to January 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 2, General Services Agreement – Tulum Innovative Engineering, Inc. – Cole Data Center Move Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Awards DecoTech a $101,100 contract for new security cameras at Santa Fe Elementary
enrichment.summary: DecoTech Systems was the lowest responsive bidder, and the Board is approving its contract to install about 21 new security cameras, fix about 7 existing ones, add spare cameras and replace the camera recording server at Santa Fe Elementary School. The amount includes a $9,000.00 contingency fee. Work is expected from January 15 to April 15, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - DecoTech Systems, Inc., - Division of Facilities and Planning Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $292,398 to Ninyo & Moore's contract for soil and groundwater testing at Coliseum College Prep
enrichment.summary: The Board is adding $292,398.12 so Ninyo & Moore can prepare and carry out a preliminary endangerment assessment (PEA) work plan for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy site expansion. The work includes 38 soil borings, 6 groundwater borings, 6 soil gas wells and 157 samples. The contract limit rises from $14,490.00 to $306,888.12.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $26,137.54 for King Construction Inspection on the solar panel Phase 2 and 3 projects
enrichment.summary: The Board is adding $26,137.54 for more inspection services by King Construction Inspection, the certified inspector of record who checks that materials and construction meet Division of the State Architect (DSA) requirements on the Solar Photovoltaics Phase 2 and 3 projects. The contract limit rises from $37,598.00 to $63,735.54.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $557,442.47 to Cahill's Fremont High modernization contract for pier and steel changes
enrichment.summary: The Board is approving a change order adding $557,442.47 to the lease-leaseback construction contract with Cahill Contractors for the Fremont High School modernization. The added Phase II work includes drilled pier changes, larger steel beams, added welded studs, wider piers and a revised concrete pour plan. The contract limit rises from $10,922,885.00 to $11,480,327.47.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Extends Inspection Services' Fremont High testing and inspection contract a year at no added cost
enrichment.summary: The Board is extending the contract with Inspection Services, Inc. for continued special inspection and testing at the Fremont High School modernization. The end date moves from December 31, 2025 to December 31, 2026 (365 more days), and the text says there is no increase in cost.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $444,522.91 to ACC Environmental's hazardous materials work at the fire-damaged Bunche portables
enrichment.summary: The Board is adding $444,522.91 for more hazardous materials management, air monitoring, sampling and technical oversight for the three portable structures damaged by fire at Ralph J. Bunche. The work is part of the Bunche demolition project. The contract limit rises from $233,304.20 to $677,827.11.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The Board is adding $16,800.00 so Jensen Hughes can provide fire alarm and intrusion alarm services for the Melrose Leadership Academy fire alarm and fire sprinkler project. This is the 14th amendment to the master engineering agreement, and the limit rises from $758,212.00 to $775,012.00.
